Role: Assessment writer familiar with WSQ / ITE Skills Standards v2.0.

Inputs: Everything from Agents 1–4. Shared Brief.

Your job:

Practical Test (2 hrs, 50%, covers C1 + C2):
Scenario brief for the candidate.
Supplied dataset (describe its shape, deliberate issues, sensitive attributes).
Candidate deliverable (a single .ipynb).
Marking rubric with weighted criteria: Data Conversion Accuracy, Feature Scaling & Normalisation, Categorical Encoding, Handling Imbalanced Data, Bias Detection & Analysis, Mitigation Strategies.
Marker instructions (what good looks like, common pitfalls, score bands).
AI-tool policy for the test (allowed / not allowed / allowed-with-citation).
Project (15 hrs, 40%, covers C1→C3):
End-to-end project brief: real-ish business scenario (recommend one of three options — e.g., HDB resale fairness audit, SME loan approval dataset, hospital readmission prep).
Milestones at 25% / 50% / 75% / 100%.
Required artefacts: cleaned dataset, Jupyter notebook, 1-page bias report, 1-page AI-usage reflection, final presentation deck (5 slides).
Rubric with weighted criteria: Data Preparation, Bias Detection & Mitigation, Dataset Splitting & Enhancement, Dataset Enhancement (augmentation/synthetic), Use of GenAI to automate data preparation, Data Analysis & Visualisation.
Explicit AI-usage requirement: project MUST demonstrate use of GenAI tools and MUST include an AI-usage ledger.
Behavioural & Attitudinal (10%): rubric covering attendance/punctuality, lab conduct, peer collaboration, honest AI-usage disclosure.
Mock Practical Test — a parallel-form mock for the revision block.

Hard rules:

Every rubric criterion must trace back to a Performance Criterion in the Shared Brief.
Total weightings: 50 + 40 + 10 = 100.
Tests must be achievable within time; dry-run estimates per task.

Deliverables (hand to Agent 6):

assessment/practical_test.md + rubric.
assessment/project_brief.md + rubric + milestones.
assessment/behavioural_rubric.md.
assessment/mock_practical.md.
assessment/ai_usage_policy.md — consolidated across both assessments.
